title: centaurium turneri
intro: Centaurium turneri, commonly known as Turners centaury or mountain bluet, is a flowering plant species in the gentian family. It is traditionally used to treat digestive issues, sore throats, and coughs due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium turneri include its ability to soothe digestive problems, calm coughs, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides, such as centaurin, gentiopicroside, and amarogentin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
